custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test, with Min 2 and Max 6.
  • Have a parts import file with one row for part A with the same values except Min 4 (Max stays 6).
  • Start on the Inventory data import page (click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Inventory under IMPORTS in the left menu; the page is titled Inventory Import Preview).
